resource_risks.description: Accumulated data overview could scan too many runtime files if stores grow.
resource_risks.mitigation: Directory metadata scan is capped by MAX_ACCUMULATED_DATA_SCAN_FILES per store and returns summaries, not full file contents.

resource_risks.description: A runtime data scan could follow symlinks or behave like a source tree browser.
resource_risks.mitigation: The scan uses symlink_metadata and skips symlink entries; the UI exposes runtime store paths and summaries rather than recursive source browsing.

lifecycle_checks.cleanup_path: No persistent process, watcher, timer, or open handle is created; fs metadata calls return before command completion.
evidence: corepack pnpm --filter workspace-monitor run check: passed

measurement_checks.metric: files scanned per accumulated data store
measurement_checks.tool: source inspection plus Rust compile check

notes: No global install, daemon, long-running server, watcher, polling interval, or destructive cleanup was added.
